name: Setup map
narration_excerpt: Ashoka ruled the largest empire India had yet seen. Around 261 BCE, he invaded Kalinga, an independent kingdom on the east coast.

narration_excerpt: So: was this a king in pain, or a king managing his image?

name: Evidence both ways
narration_excerpt: The case for sincerity: he urges people to watch themselves for cruelty, anger, pride and envy. He funds medicine for people and animals, and wells along the roads. The case for strategy: he keeps the death penalty, and warns forest tribes that, remorse or not, he can still punish them.
